hypothesis: The useful tail in V6 exploration is temporally coherent at the grasp-option level. Keeping one small hand-only pre-tanh residual fixed from handoff through a short CLOSE window can create force closure more often than independent action noise, while exact V6 SEARCH, arm authority, public latch, and frozen LIFT remain unchanged.

why_not_more_behavior_cloning.conclusion: The loss is before stable grasp, not in common frozen LIFT. Averaging successful noisy actions changed the action mean without increasing grasp incidence.

mean_head_only_counterfactual.reason: It halves Candidate38 drift but retains the same success-conditioned mean target and provides no new exploration signal.

single_mechanism.name: episode_coherent_pre_latch_hand_residual
single_mechanism.active_rows: option_active and public_latch==0 and never_previously_latched and close_age<32
single_mechanism.first_latch_retirement: sticky for the rest of the episode, including after any later latch release
single_mechanism.arm_action: exact V6 authority output; exact zero during CLOSE
single_mechanism.raw_z_distribution: SHA256-derived standard normal, one z14 per seed/env_slot, clipped symmetrically to [-2,2] only when applied
single_mechanism.antithetic_pairing: SHA256-ranked first and second halves are strict +z/-z pairs; replicate b complements treatment without redrawing z

scale_basis.window_basis: All 26 sealed safe-success CLOSE fragments first latched at close_age 11 through 31, i.e. within 12 through 32 actions when the trigger action at age zero is counted.

episode_fields: trajectory maximum force and true-clearance maximum
step_fields: obs115 and exact V6 raw mean hand14
transition grasp, grasp quality, hold quality, force, and true clearance
artifact_requirements.provenance: clean committed source, exact checkpoint hashes, runtime asset hashes, FlashSAC fork commit, CUDA/Isaac/runtime versions
cross_replicate_checks: raw_z, antithetic pairing, and signs are bit-exact
SEARCH, V6 actor, task contract, and frozen LIFT hashes are identical

non_evidence_smoke.purpose: validate live action routing, budgets, first-latch retirement, artifact publication, and safety before evidence collection

randomized_development_discovery.estimand: development-only effect of the fixed coherent-residual distribution, not a deployable deterministic policy

direction_extraction_if_gates_pass.domain: same seed/env_slot triggered and produced at least one eligible 32-action-window row in both complementary replicates; SEARCH-before-handoff latch-and-release slots are excluded because the sticky intervention was already retired
direction_extraction_if_gates_pass.primary_outcome: first public latch occurs on a CLOSE action with close_age<32
direction_extraction_if_gates_pass.paired_advantage: treatment primary outcome minus control primary outcome for the same seed/env_slot
direction_extraction_if_gates_pass.gradient: sum over domain of paired_advantage * clamp(raw_z14,-2,2)
direction_extraction_if_gates_pass.fixed_z_star: clip(gradient / RMS(gradient), -2, 2), computed in float64 then sealed as exact float32
direction_extraction_if_gates_pass.failure_if: fewer than eight discordant outcomes or zero/non-finite gradient
direction_extraction_if_gates_pass.next_evidence: commit immutable fixed_z.pt plus manifest before using reserved seeds 329 and 330
direction_extraction_if_gates_pass.no_claim: randomized discovery cannot establish that fixed_z_star improves grasp or success

scale_escalation_rule.allowed_only_if: main scale has no usable grasp direction and has zero drop, zero unsafe force, and zero saturation violations

formal_acceptance_rule.additional_primary_gate: conditional latched-within-32 delta must be positive

decision_rule: Implement and test without simulator evidence; seal this plan and exact source commit; run the non-evidence smoke; only then collect the fixed development runs in order. Do not tune thresholds, scale, horizon, z, or run order after seeing outcomes.
